scenario.title: Comparable visible fallout beds
scenario.assumption: The original-fallout equivalent needed for a visible bed at the checked lake and peat is at most the thickness of a documented visible B-Tm bed in a comparable sedimentary setting. The Lake Ogawara OG12-2 visible layer is 1 cm. The margin of Larchenkov bog has a B-Tm ash layer up to 2 cm thick, while the central bog preserved cryptotephra. Matrix, sorting and preservation differ between archives. The model conditions on this transfer.

controls.measurement: B-Tm ash up to 2 cm at the margin. The centre has only cryptotephra.
controls.source: Razjigaeva et al. (2020), distribution of the ash layer
